com.invoiceparserpro/capability.description: Create an active rule for future matching invoices, such as flagging, approval or client/account assignment. Auto-approval can trigger configured accounting export. Export and reviewer-notification actions are configured in IPP. Review and confirm the exact change first. The preview expires after five minutes.
examples: Preview creating an active rule named Fictional Supplier review, priority 100: when vendor_name contains Fictional Supplier, flag for review with note Check supplier details. Show its future actions and wait for my confirmation.

Preview creating an auto-approval rule named Fictional USD small bills for vendor_name equal to Fictional Supplier, confidence high, validation_status valid and USD total_amount at most 200. Explain possible automatic accounting export after approval and wait for my confirmation.
